blocks.text: Globe Platinum members welcomed the arrival of the iPhone 18 Pro series with an exclusive midnight launch at The Pig & Palm, combining the latest in mobile technology with a curated dining experience. Globe Platinum brought the iPhone 18 Pro series closer to its members through an exclusive midnight launch at The Pig & Palm in Cebu on October 16, 2026, giving loyal customers a more personalized way to welcome the latest iPhone release. More than a traditional product launch, the gathering transformed the wait for the new devices into a premium experience, allowing guests to enjoy an intimate evening of […]...
